status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-04. Kept on record, not deleted.
learn_source: Watch the herbalist damp the seedling beds at the edge of the Forager's Clearing — tonic herbs are delicate and a bucket would flatten them
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a planted thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the mist is fine and even across the whole bed; at baseline it falls patchy and close. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: wilting, the leaves lift and firm within the hour; already watered, the extra beads off and nothing changes
State-dependent: lit, the flame gutters out under the damp; unlit, the wick is merely wet and harder to light
Beads and runs off — a wet stone, nothing more
No physical effect — the mist parts around the animal without wetting it
receivers.reaction_kind: recoil-hop sideways, suspicious sniff at the damp ground

receivers.physical_outcome: No physical effect — his coat stays dry
receivers.reaction_kind: wonder — turns the miss into an inspection of how the droplets parted
